notes.title: [Until the Portal opens again..]
notes.notes:
[b][h2]It's a wrap- the Playtest has officially come to an end! 
[/h2][/b]

[h3]As of 08:00 (UTC+0), the Playtest for World of the dead has officially concluded! We sincerely thank all our survivors who have been following us on this unforgettable journey![/h3]

The Playtest is over, but the journey of World of the dead is far from over. our team is thrilled to share that we will be introducing a new version of the game in the near future. As we plan to reveal more news regarding project periodically, we hope survivors will stay with us for more deadly updates to come. 

Since the response to the Playtest was beyond our wildest expectations, we are now hard at work, building upon the valuable feedback and insights every survivor provided during the Playtest to refine and enhance the project even further.

We invite you to stay with us on this journey by following our official Discord and social media channels. We will make sure to keep you posted on any progress we make through our official channels.

Farewell, survivors! Until the portal between hell and earth opens again..

notes.title: [Playtest Ends Tomorrow!]
notes.notes:
Greetings, Survivors. 

The end of the World of the dead Playtest is just a day away! A huge thanks to all survivors who have actively participated and provided insightful suggestions and feedback so far.

As previously noted, the Playtest will conclude on November 4, 08:00 (UTC+0). With just one day left, we encourage all survivors to make the most of the remaining time by exploring the content available in game, and trying out the various weapon groups featured in the game.

Our team also welcomes all feedback and suggestions, as every survivor’s perspective is valuable to us. If you have any thoughts on how World of the dead can improve further, feel free to share them with us in the suggestions-feedback channel on our official Discord server. 

We hope you enjoy World of the dead to the fullest during this final day!

notes.title: [Playtest Survey announcement]
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Hello, Survivors!
[/h2][/b]

Hope everyone is enjoying the Playtest experience so far! Our team would like to extend our sincere thanks to all participating survivors for joining us in this Playtest.

As we approach the halfway mark of the Playtest, we have prepared another survey for all survivors with thoughts and feedback to share with us on the Playtest so far. Your insights are very important for us to shape World of the dead in the right direction.


[b]■ [Survey period]
[/b]
[list]
[*] UTC+0: November 1, 09:00 ~ November 8, 23:59
[*] KST: November 1, 18:00 ~ November 9, 08:59
[/list]

This survey is open to all survivors participating in the Playtest. All participants who complete the survey will have a chance to receive a special reward in future releases of World of the dead.

[b]■ [Reward]
[/b]
[list]
[*] TBD (Please note that the content of this reward is still being finalised, and we will inform you once details are confirmed.)
[/list]

Survey link: [url=https://forms.gle/ouEMWwPfmbUmVLCh8]https://forms.gle/ouEMWwPfmbUmVLCh8[/url]

Your valuable feedback is crucial. We look forward to your participation!

notes.title: [11/01 Patch Notes]
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Greetings, Survivors!
[/h2][/b]

With the start of november, our team will be conducting an update on November 1. 
Please refer to the following description for detailed patch information. 


[b]■ Date and Time:
[/b]
From
[i]08:00 ~ 09:00 on November 1, 2024 (UTC+0)
17:00 ~ 18:00 on November 1, 2024 (KST)[/i]


[b]■ Update details:
[/b]
[Map rebalancing]
[list]
[*] In order to enhance the gameplay experience, a rebalancing will be implemented across all maps.
[*] Reduced difficulty of Wasteland.
[/list]

[Quality of life update]
[list]
[*] Removed Issaquah's gear score restriction.
[*] Reduced item loss on failed extractions for players under level 10.
[*] Fixed an issue where weapon flashlights would turn on automatically at the start of a round.
[/list]

[Bug Fixes]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug regarding the tutorial.
[*] Fixed an issue where Korean text would appear in the character creation screen in the client set in languages other than Korean
[/list]

[b]■ Event:
[/b]
[Medical Center]
[list]
[*] With this patch, Medical Center, a notorious hotspot known for its formidable monsters will be available for play.
[/list]
